_comment: Constitution Profile Example — copy to .methodology/constitution_profile.json and customize

_docs.description: This file controls how the constitution checker evaluates your project artifacts.
_docs.load_order: 1. Built-in defaults (shown here)  2. .methodology/constitution_profile.json  3. METHODOLOGY_CONSTITUTION_PROFILE env var (JSON string)
_docs.merge_rules: Non-empty lists replace defaults. Empty list ([]) means 'keep existing'. Dicts are merged key-by-key. Omitted keys keep defaults. Omitted numeric thresholds keep existing values (not reset to defaults).
_docs.quick_start: To change the coverage threshold for Phase 4: set dimensions.coverage.threshold to your value. To add custom keywords for security: set dimensions.security.keywords to your full list.

scoring._description: Aggregate score = minimum across all active dimensions (bottleneck principle). Currently only 'min_of_dimensions' is supported.

phases._description: Per-phase active dimensions and composite score threshold. active_dimensions: which of the 4 dimensions are checked. composite_threshold: minimum overall score to pass.

dimensions._description: Each dimension has: threshold (0-100), keywords (used for density scoring), rule (TH reference for violation reporting), hardcoded_secret_patterns (only for security).

file_filters._description: Maps check_type → filename keywords. When constitution check is run with a specific check_type, only files whose names contain one of these keywords are scanned. 'all' check_type scans everything.

phase_dir_map._description: Maps phase number → project directory name. Used to locate phase-specific artifacts during scanning.

exclude_patterns._description: Glob patterns for files excluded from constitution keyword-density scanning. Matched against file basename with fnmatch. Per-phase patterns (phases.N.exclude_patterns) are additive.
exclude_patterns._why: Meta-documents like HANDOVER.md and STAGE_PASS.md contain operational logs — zero constitution keywords. Scanning them would dilute the aggregate keyword density below phase thresholds.
